text: This FiftyFive Technologies Policy on leave and attendance policy is released for use in FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited with effect from 01 January 2026. This document is subject to FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited Procedure and subject to change any time as per the company policy.

Additional Leaves Each comprising of specific sub-categories as defined under the respective leave provisions. Leave Provisions Monthly Leaves Leaves are provided on a monthly pro-rata basis and are accrued at the beginning of each month. Employees are entitled to a total of 24 leaves per year, comprising Casual Leave (CL) and Privilege Leave (PL). Employees are expected to plan and apply for their leaves in advance through the HRIS Leave Management System to enable effective project and resource planning.

Casual Leave: Purpose The purpose of the Casual Leave Policy is to enable employees to plan short-term time off from work for personal and unforeseen requirements. Casual Leave may be availed for reasons such as rest and de-stressing, personal commitments, appearing for examinations, family events (including marriage of family members), minor illness, or other personal exigencies. Eligibility This Policy is applicable to:
All Full-time employees of FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited including support staff, trainees and probationers. This policy is not applicable to:
Business Associates, Associate Consultant / Contractual Employee, Freelancers Provisions
The employees are entitled to 12 working days of Casual leave every year.
The year for the purpose of leave accounting is the year from January to December.
These types of leaves are a part of the total of 24 leaves allowed to an employee in a year that can be taken for some casual work.
The casual leave will be credited on a pro rata monthly basis, i.e. 1 in a month.
The leave entitlement for the year is prorated every month to arrive at the monthly entitlement.
The entitlement for each month is credited at the beginning of each month.
All Unutilized Causal leaves lapse at the end of the calendar year and cannot be reimbursed through any monetary means.
Availing the benefits:

The leave may be prefixed and or suffixed with other leave types/weekends/statutory holidays. Intervening weekends and holidays are not counted as Casual Leave days and cannot be combined with Paternity Leave, Maternity Leave, Adoption Leave, Exam Leave.
These leaves can only be combined with Privilege leave; Floater Leave and Bereavement Leave.
Leaves may be applied for a minimum of half a day.

Employees may apply for leave multiple times during the year, subject to availability of the balance. However, such applicants must not violate the principle and purpose for which casual leave is provided.
Leave when availed more than 2 days needs to be informed well in advance before a prior notice of 7 days.
The leave days in a request may span across the years.
The leaves cannot be applied after availing the same, hence no back-date leaves can be applied. If not, the applied prior may use his/her discretion to convert this into a Loss of pay.
If the employee applies for Casual Leave but does not avail of the same due to any reason, he/she may choose to cancel the same.

New Joined: The employee can avail leave if he/she has sufficient balance. Casual Leave for employees who join during the year will be credited after their first payroll run and their entitlement will be prorated based on their joining.
Employee goes on leave without pay (LWP): The employee is not entitled to leave when he/she is on leave without pay, hence there will be no leave of credit for the duration of the LWP.
Employee serving notice period: The employee serving period cannot avail of Casual leave at the time they have started serving the notice period.
Employee in Performance Improvement Plan (PIP): The employee in PIP cannot avail of Casual leave at this time. Terms and Conditions
You are not allowed to apply past day leave. Your manager or HR manager can apply on your behalf.
Casual Leave requires comment while applying for leave.
Casual Leave cannot be applied when in the notice period and during the performance improvement plan.
Casual Leave cannot be taken along with Paternity Leave, Maternity Leave, Exam Leave, Adoption Leave.

In case the leave is rejected after it is availed, and the employee is still on leave, it will be considered a loss of pay and the employee will be subject to disciplinary actions based on HR’s discretion.

During the leave period, the employee cannot take up any part-time or full-time employment of remuneration or otherwise, for any reason whatsoever. Procedure Applying for Leave: o The employee can apply for leave through the Keka Portal. o Login to KEKA-Go to Me section- Click on Leave- Apply for Leave. o The employee completed the leave application form and submitted it for approval of the same. Note: The employee can also view the details of previous leaves availed and outstanding balance through the KEKA app. Approval Workflow: o The leave goes for two levels of approval: to the employee's immediate Reporting Manager and to the Branch Head.

Privileged Leave (PL) Purpose This Policy is designed to enable employees to plan their time off from work. The purpose of the privilege leave policy is to grant the employee a fixed number of days off from work. As a benefit they have earned on account of working for a specific number of days in a particular period. Eligibility This Policy is applicable to:
All Full-time employees of FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited including trainees and probationers. This policy is not applicable to:
Support Staff, Business Associates, Associate Consultant / Contractual Employee, Freelancers Provisions
The employees are entitled to 12 working days of Privilege Leaves every year.
The year for the purpose of leave accounting is the year from January to December.
These types of leaves are a part of the total of 24 leaves allowed to an employee in a year.
The leave of entitlement for the year is prorated on a monthly basis to arrive at the monthly entitlement. The entitlement for each month is credited at the beginning of each month.
Employees can avail the leave balance of upcoming months in advance based on the accumulated balance of projection.
Leaves that are entitled to be carried forward will be up to the days as maximum of 12 in a year.
The encashment is processed in the financial year, i.e. March month.

The maximum accumulation of privilege leave balances is capped at a maximum of 24 days. Number of days left in excess of 24, accumulated till the end of the calendar year are treated as “Surplus” in the month of December.
Any excess beyond 24 days will be subject to encashment, and employees will be required to either avail of those leaves or the surplus balance into encashment.
Availing the benefits:

Employees may apply for leave multiple times during the year, subject to availability of the balance to be informed well in advance of at least 15 days of notice. However, such applicants must not violate the principle and purpose for which casual leave is provided.
Leaves may be applied for a minimum of full days. There is no limit on the maximum number of days, subject to availability of balance.
In a month, employees can avail maximum up to 5 days of Privilege leave.
In a year, employees can avail maximum up to 12 days of Privilege leave.
The leaves cannot be applied after availing the same, hence no back date leaves can be applied. If not applied prior may use his/her discretion to convert this into Loss of pay.
If the employee applies Privilege Leave but does not avail of the same due to any reason, he/she may choose to cancel the same.

The leave may be prefixed and or suffixed with weekends/statutory holidays. Intervening weekends and holidays are not counted as privilege leave days and cannot be combined with Maternity, Adoption, Paternity and Exam Leaves.
The encashment formula is followed as mentioned below: Encashment amount = (last drawn basic salary of the last calendar year /number of days within a year) * eligible leave balance.
The employee can avail leave if he/she has sufficient balance.
Privilege leave is credited only after the employee has served his probation period.
Employee goes on leave without pay (LWP): The employee is not entitled to leave when he/she is on leave without pay, hence there will be no leave of credit for the duration of the LWP.
Employee serving notice period: The employee serving period cannot avail of Privilege leave at the time they have started serving the notice period.
Employee Retirement: In case of retirement, the accumulated leave balance as of the date of retirement is encashed and paid to the employee in full and final accordance with the encashment formula.
Employee Death: In case of death, the accumulated leave balance as of the date of death is encashed and paid to the nominee.
Employee in Performance Improvement Plan (PIP): The employee in PIP cannot avail of Privilege leave at the time. Terms and Conditions:
There is a provision for an employee to apply for Advance Privileged leave which is that the employee has to inform the reporting manager/HR Department prior to 15 days of the leave to occur.
During the leave period, the employee cannot take up any part-time or full-time employment for remuneration or otherwise, for any reason whatsoever.
In case the leave exceeds the balance allotted in a month, it will result in a loss of pay, based on the HR manager’s discretion.

In case the employee does not report back to his/her supervisor on the leave end date, the excess leave will be treated as unauthorized leave. Such unauthorized leave will be applied by HR and will result in a loss of pay.

FiftyFive Technologies reserves the right to initiate an exit procedure in case of the following: ❖ The employee does not report back by the approved leave end date and does not inform the supervisor. ❖ Privilege Leave cannot be applied when in the notice period or in the performance improvement Plan.
These leaves can only be combined with Casual Leave, Floater Leave, and Bereavement Leave.
Privilege Leave cannot be taken along with Paternity Leave, Maternity Leave, Exam Leave, or Adoption Leave.

The leaves can be approved or rejected by the reporting manager or the HR Manager based on the project requirements. Procedure Applying for Leave: o The employee can apply for leave through the Keka Portal. o Login to KEKA-Go to Me section- Click on Leave- Apply for Leave. o The employee completed the leave application form and submitted it for approval of the same. Note: The employee can also view the details of previous leaves availed and outstanding balance through the KEKA app. Approval Workflow: o The leave goes for two levels of approval: to the employee's immediate Reporting Manager and to the Branch Head. Leave Calculation of Monthly Leaves: Let us frame examples to understand better- CASE I: For Casual Leaves Let us assume that Ram joined FiftyFive on 1st January and avails 5 leaves till September. As per the leave policy, his accrued leave till September is 1*9 =9 (1 leave provided per month). So, after consuming his 5 leaves, the balance available for September is 4 leaves out of 9 accrued so far and the remaining balance will be 3 out of a total annual quota of 12 till December. CASE II: For Privilege leaves Let us assume that Ram joined FiftyFive on 1st January and avails 5 leaves till September. As per the leave policy, his accrued leaves till September is 1*9 =9 (1 leave provided per month). So, after consuming his 5 leaves, the balance available in September is 4 leave out of 9 accrued so far and remaining balance will be 3 out of total annual quota of 12 till December. Let us assume that Ram has completed 3 years with FiftyFive and wants to know his total balance of PL and the encashment process. As per the leave policy, his entitlement of leaves till December is 1*12 =12 (1 leave provided per month). The same pointer is applied for next both years. So, his total leave balance would be of 36 (12+12+12) from which his extra leave balance exceeding from 24 will be eligible for encashment i.e. 12 which will be encashed to him in the financial year i.e. in March and rest balance will be carried forward again until availed. Incase Ram resigns between the third year or so, then his accumulated balance (24 carried forward leaves and accumulated till that year) will be given as encashment during his full and final settlement. Let us assume that Ram has completed 3 years with FiftyFive and wants to consume his leaves along with encashment. This benefit can be claimed by a female employee during her employment period at the company.
The Maternity Leave will be limited only up to 2 children and can be availed with one instance per year and only twice during the tenure with the company.
Maternity Leave is event based and cannot be encashed or accumulated.
If the employee applied for Maternity Leave but does not avail of the same due to any reason, he may choose to cancel the same.
An Employee may avail of Maternity Leave for the following reasons:

In Case of Childbirth and Pregnancy: Every married female employee will be allowed to take 182 calendar days of leave in one go for her child. ii) In Case of a miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy: Every married female employee is entitled to avail for 6 weeks of paid leave immediately. following the date of the miscarriage or the medical termination of her pregnancy. iii) In case the employee undergoes a Tubectomy operation: Every married female employee is entitled to avail 2 weeks of paid leave immediately following the date of her Tubectomy operation.
Availing the Benefit:
Eligible employees may apply for maternity leave twice during their tenure in FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited but only one maternity leave request will be permitted in the same instance per year.
The other leave types/ weekends/statutory holidays falling during the period of leave will be considered as leave days.
Maternity leave should be planned in advance at least 30 calendar days prior before availing the same in case of childbirth.
All the leave days in a request should be availed continuously without any break.
New Joinees: Female employees can avail the balance once they have served 80 days with the company.
Employee goes on leave without pay (LWP): The female employee is not entitled for leave when she is on leave without pay, hence there will be no leave credit for the duration of the LWP.

Login to KEKA-Go to Me section- Click on Leave- Apply for Leave.

The applicant should inform about her pregnancy to the HR department minimum 30 Days in advance before proceeding on leave.
The application should be supported by a medical certificate confirming the pregnancy and expected date of childbirth.
Maternity leave cannot be combined with accrued Privilege leave, Floater Leaves, Casual Leave, Paternity Leave, Bereavement Leave, Exam Leave, Adoption Leave.
Non-availed Maternity Leave is not cashable. The weekly offs and holidays falling during this period will be part of the leaves availed (they will also count as leaves).

Upon exhaustion of the approved maternity leave entitlement, an employee may apply for an extension of leave for a maximum of 30 (thirty) days as Loss of Pay (LOP), subject to business requirements and management approval.

Any extension beyond the permissible 30 days of LOP shall not be allowed and may be treated as a policy violation, which could lead to disciplinary action in accordance with the Company’s disciplinary policy and applicable labor laws.
The employee must inform the HR Department in writing, in advance, if she intends to extend her absence beyond the approved maternity leave period.
Any extension of leave or LOP must be approved in advance by both the Reporting Manager and HR. Absence without prior approval may be treated as unauthorized leave.
The Company reserves the right to take appropriate action in compliance with statutory obligations while ensuring fair and consistent application of this policy.

The appraisal cycle, eligibility, or prorated performance assessment (if applicable) may be reviewed based on the actual period of active service, subject to management discretion and statutory compliance.
